name: Kubo Akiko
source:
The female president of "Kubo Air Transport", the company that the main characters belong to. A beautiful woman with dark, long hair with ponytails and always has sleepy eyes. As she was the former chief operator of the Ikaros Project, Katsura and John were her colleagues.

After the Ikaros Project, she was invited to join the space elevator construction "Project Daidaros" but declined. She started "Kubo Air" with Katsura and John. She doesn't usually show this, but she deeply loves Keima...

"...Ah~ What happened...? ...There's... some trouble...?"
